description: This file defines the MessageSender interface for publishing messages to the Hono platform, including methods for sending messages, closing the sender, and retrieving endpoint information.

classes.name: MessageSender
classes.description: An interface for sending messages to Hono, supporting different delivery semantics and integration with tracing and asynchronous handling.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the name of the endpoint this sender sends messages to (implementation-specific).

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the AMQP link with the Hono server, invoking the provided handler upon completion.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the sender is (locally) open and capable of sending messages.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an AMQP message asynchronously, returning a Future that indicates the outcome.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Default method that sends a message with optional tracing context, delegating to the primary send method.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the disposition confirming its outcome, returning a Future.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Default method that sends a message and waits for outcome with optional tracing context, delegating to the primary method.
